children: Jeff Bezos has become the world's second-richest person after his space company Blue Origin reached a $140 billion valuation in a new funding round.

The valuation lifted Bezos' estimated fortune by $87 billion to $368.5 billion, moving him ahead of Google (GOOGL) co-founder Larry Page. Only Elon Musk, with an estimated $1.02 trillion, ranks higher, Bloomberg reported.

Blue Origin raised $10 billion in its first outside funding round. Investment firm Coatue Management contributed roughly $4 billion, while Bezos added about $2 billion. Despite the outside capital, Bezos retains approximately 93% ownership of the company he founded in 2000 and has largely self-funded.

Blue Origin expects to resume New Glenn rocket launches in December after a launch-pad explosion in May delayed the program.

title: Amazon founder Jeff Bezos becomes world's second-richest person
